visual.general_description: Colour-coded faces from mild to very severe above two lists of coping actions, one headed Pain and one headed Exhaustion.
visual.detailed_description: Infographic-style diagram on a white background. At the top is a horizontal gradient bar running from green on the left through yellow, orange and pink to purple on the right, with a short vertical stroke printed at its left end and the printed number "10" at its right end. Below the bar is a row of five round faces with simple eyes and mouths: a green face with a smile labelled "Mild", a yellow face with a small smile labelled "Moderate", an orange face with a straight mouth labelled "Moderate To severe", a pink face with a frown labelled "Severe", and a purple face with a deeper frown labelled "Very severe". Under this are two column headings, "Pain" in pink and "Exhaustion" in teal. To the left of the columns the five faces repeat in the same order from top to bottom (green, yellow, orange, pink, purple). The Pain column lists, top to bottom, "compression, distraction (reading, tv, YouTube), regulate temperature", "Massage chair", "Fibrocream", "Panadol", "Lay on floor", "Massage ball", "Mental exercises", "Heat pad", "Change positions", "Sleep", "Affirmations", "‘This will soon pass’", "‘Pain is temporary’", "Finding least painful position" and "Massage". The Exhaustion column lists, top to bottom, "Sleep", "Prioritize to do list", "Massage chair", "Get comfortable (bed)", "Stretch", "Eat", "Lay on floor", "Rest in a quiet and dark place" and "Sleep till it’s gone". No arrows, panel letters, patient names or dates are drawn on the image.
